title: models.json: the models a meeting's own transcript and minutes are made with
description: session-audio/v3 — written by the shell on the user's word, read by the shell alone, for a meeting of any version. What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page: that a part absent is Settings' choice, that `confidential` comes first, and that a part this schema refuses reads as absent.

transcription.description: Who hears the meeting: a Whisper model of this computer, named by its file alone; Apple's SpeechAnalyzer; or a service, at its address, with its model's name.

minutes.description: Who writes the minutes: a provider's address and its model's name, as kitokey-summary takes them.

name.description: Text of one line, never empty: never a key, and for a Whisper model never a path.
